steps.name: Welcome
content: # Welcome to the TNY-360 V2 assembly guide!
This guide is split into multiple sections, each focusing on a specific part of the assembly process.
Use the `Prev` and `Next` buttons to navigate through the steps, and refer to the images for visual guidance.

content.text: Congratulations! You have completed the assembly of your TNY-360 V2 🥳 !
